Anyhow, here's some new pix, taken 4/6/15 to show the subtle different variations. Here's the faces of Extreme red throat aka ERT (as opposed to the faces of Meth):


Extreme even as it just opens. With some clones, you don't see any red at all right when it opens, but as the trap ages, the red is just as extreme as other clones:
